summary: Iteration 237 - Batch 25 (Digital Tipping via Stripe Checkout) tested. Backend: 23/23 passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified and working including public tip page, success/cancel pages, and admin TippingPanel with Dashboard and QR tabs.

minor.issue: TRY currency requires higher minimum amount (~50 TRY) due to Stripe's 50 cents USD equivalent minimum. 5 TRY (~$0.11) fails with 500 error.
minor.note: This is a Stripe limitation, not a bug. Consider adding currency-specific minimum amounts in validation.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/tipping/landing/{property_id} (PUBLIC) returns property info, branding, suggested_amounts [2,5,10,20,50], currency 'gbp'. Accepts ?staff_id=X for staff info.

POST /api/tipping/session (PUBLIC) creates Stripe checkout session. Validates: amount 0.5..500, currency in (gbp|eur|usd|try), staff_role in allowed set. Returns session_id, checkout_url (cs_test_*), tip_id.

POST /api/tipping/session correctly rejects: amount < 0.5 (400 'Minimum tip amount is 0.50'), amount > 500 (400 'Maximum tip amount is 500'), invalid currency (400 'Unsupported currency'), invalid staff_role (400 'Invalid staff_role').
GET /api/tipping/status/{session_id} (PUBLIC) polls Stripe and returns status, amount, currency. Returns 404 for nonexistent session.
GET /api/tipping/leaderboard/{property_id} (ADMIN) returns total_amount, total_count, avg_tip, leaderboard[], by_role[], recent_messages[]. Validates days 1..365.
GET /api/tipping/list/{property_id} (ADMIN) returns tip rows with optional status filter.
Admin endpoints correctly return 401 without auth, 403 for non-admin roles (receptionist).
Webhook at /api/webhook/stripe handles type='tip' metadata to mark tips as 'paid'.
Frontend public /tip/{property_id} renders TipForm with property hero, 5 suggested amounts (£2/£5/£10/£20/£50), custom amount input, guest name, message, submit button.
Frontend /tip/success polls status every 2s up to 12 attempts; shows checking spinner then paid confirmation or timeout message.
Frontend /tip/cancel renders cancel UI with 'Geri Dön' (Go Back) button.
Frontend admin TippingPanel has 2 tabs: 'Lider Tablosu' (Dashboard) with KPIs, days filter, leaderboard, messages; 'QR Linki' with QR code image, property link, copy button.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tip sessions created during testing are stored in db.tips collection
